comparison: Perfect agreement on affinity measurements and mutagenesis validation (C63-C67). Both evaluations find the SPR data and functional validation strongly support the structural model. OpenEval and peer reviewers both rate as SUPPORTED.

Strong agreement on background context (C4, C5, C19, C20, C100-C106). Both accept the prior published work establishing ISG65's biological importance. OpenEval and peer reviewers both rate as SUPPORTED with appropriate citations.

Strong agreement on receptor occlusion findings (C12, C91-C93, C96, C97, C99). Both accept structural comparisons showing overlap with CR2/CR3 but not CRIg/CR1. Both rate as SUPPORTED, though OpenEval notes lack of direct experimental validation of receptor blocking.

Strong agreement on contextualization and limitations (C115, C116, C119-C121). Both evaluations approve of how authors acknowledge alternative mechanisms and in vitro limitations. Both rate as SUPPORTED, viewing this as appropriate scientific caution.

Divergent evaluations of conjugate formation data (C10, C80-C87). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN due to speculative 'decoy' interpretation and lack of in vivo validation. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, accepting the biochemical findings without expressing concerns about mechanistic interpretation.

Strong agreement on convertase activity findings (C8, C9, C72-C79). Both accept that ISG65 doesn't alter convertase activity based on structural and functional data. Both rate as SUPPORTED with multiple lines of evidence.

Divergent evaluations of integrative conclusions (C14, C110-C113). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting speculative aspects of mechanistic interpretations and in vivo translation. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, viewing the multi-mechanism model as a coherent framework representing a major advance.

Strong agreement on two-interface structural findings (C6, C7, C56-C62). Both evaluations affirm the cryo-EM structure reveals distinct interfaces with interface 2 being C3b-specific. Both rate as SUPPORTED with high confidence.

Both address structural methodology (C52-C55). OpenEval includes these claims in broader structural findings rated SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers separately affirm methodology quality, describing structure as 'highly compelling' without methodological critique.

Strong agreement on sequence conservation (C108, C109). Both accept conservation analysis and functional implications across subspecies. Both rate as SUPPORTED without challenges to the conservation argument.

Overlapping claims on decoy mechanism (C88-C90). OpenEval rates conjugate formation UNCERTAIN due to speculative interpretation. Peer reviewers also rate decoy interpretation as UNCERTAIN, noting authors' own acknowledgment of speculation and need for further experimentation.

Both address conformational analysis and mechanistic distinction (C69-C71). OpenEval includes these in broader convertase findings rated SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers separately affirm the distinction from bacterial strategies, also rating SUPPORTED.

Minimal overlap on functional implications (C114). OpenEval includes this in integrative conclusions rated UNCERTAIN. Peer reviewers include it in functional inferences rated SUPPORTED, accepting mechanistic interpretations as reasonable extensions.

Minimal overlap on multi-mechanism discussion (C117). OpenEval focuses on acknowledgment of other mechanisms rated SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers include this in integrative conclusions also rated SUPPORTED, affirming the multi-mechanism framework.

Minimal overlap on immune cell recruitment (C13). OpenEval includes this in receptor occlusion findings rated SUPPORTED with caveat about lack of direct validation. Peer reviewers include it in functional inferences also rated SUPPORTED.

Partial overlap on background context (C94, C95, C98). OpenEval groups extensive background claims together rated SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers include subset in functional inferences, also rating SUPPORTED as reasonable extensions of structural findings.

Minimal overlap on structural analysis (C68). OpenEval includes map-model correlation in convertase findings rated SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers include it in methodology validation, also rating SUPPORTED without critique.

Minimal overlap on prior work (C107). OpenEval includes this in summary of previous findings rated SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers include it in broader background context, also rating SUPPORTED as establishing study importance.

OpenEval evaluates extensive background claims (C1-C3, C15-C47, C94, C95, C98, C118) as SUPPORTED, providing established context. No corresponding peer review result specifically addresses this comprehensive background grouping, though elements appear in other peer results.
